summary: Unmanaged daemon shutdown and demo cleanup verify that the state-directory and node-identity.lock flocks is released after the leader exits. Children retaining inherited lock descriptors now cause a bounded, explicit stop failure instead of a clean-stop report or state erasure. Linux diagnostics identify the processes retaining the lock. Fixes #4855.

schema.detail: No schema, ownership metadata or stored-data changes.

rules.detail: Daemon admission and state-lock acquisition rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No wire or storage changes. Uninstall and demo cleanup now refuse to erase state while a lock is retained; no new runtime dependency.

manual.detail: No upgrade action is required. A failed stop reports the retained lock for inspection before cleanup.

recovery.detail: A failed stop retains state and the demo PID receipt. No data recovery or migration is required.
